messages:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: AUTO-PAGER fired for service=inference-api route=/v1/generate region=eu-west2 metric=5xx_rate threshold=10% current=34%
pd-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-89421 created and notified escalation policy 'sre-oncall'.
sre-maya: acked on PD, joining thread. looking at metrics now.
eng-ron: on it if you need kernel-level changes. which cluster?
sre-maya: eu-west2-primary. spike started ~1943215600. buckets show 1m 5xx_rate jump around 1943218600.
sre-maya: top error code is 503 upstream: "backend-unavailable" in inference-gateway logs
sre-maya: quick grep of gateway logs: `for i in $(seq 1 100); do curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://inference.eu-west2.redwood/v1/generate; done`
eng-ron: paste of a sample stackline from gateway: `ERROR proxy.go:142: upstream call failed: connection refused -> dial tcp 10.12.4.9:8080: connect: connection refused`
sre-maya: ok looks like a backend pool flapping / pod restarts. controllers show repeated restarts for pod inference-worker-7
sre-maya: `kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide | grep inference-worker` shows restart_count 12 for worker-7
sre-maya: scaling up the worker pool to 6 -> 12 replicas to absorb; also toggling route to warm-standby model variant via feature-flag ff://route-to-small-model (low-cost compatible variant)
sre-maya: toggled flag, healthcheck for standby ok. routing shift started.
sre-maya: metrics: 5xx_rate dropped from 34% -> 9% within 60s.
support-anya: any customer-facing impact? do we need to open an incident page?
sre-maya: some requests failed for ~8 minutes; early customers on EU region might have seen 5xx for generation and embeddings. I recommend customer notice.
product-jules: agree — short status banner + support note. can you capture timeframe+affected routes?
sre-maya: timeframe ~1943218540 - 1943218780; routes: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings (small %, same backend).
eng-ron: looking at worker logs: OOMKilled on worker-7 repeatedly; it's processing a model variant with incoming seq_len spikes. raising container memory to 14G in canary patch now.
sre-maya: canary patch applied to 1 pod; observed stable for 90s -> rolling update.
pd-bot: Incident INC-89421 acknowledged by sre-maya at 1943218774.
sre-maya: adding note to runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/ops/inference-worker-flap — follow steps 1-4 for pod-level OOMs
sre-maya: also clearing KV cache warm paths to ensure cold-starts aren't causing mem spikes: `curl -X POST https://ops-api/kvcache/flush?pool=eu-west2`
eng-ron: after scaling + route shift + memory bump, we still see occasional 503s at 1-2% — likely during rolling restarts. acceptable and within SLO for now.
sre-maya: monitoring tail latency; token generation latency stable. setting PD to resolve when steady for 15m.
support-anya: I'll draft customer-facing note and post to status with estimated incident summary + affected timeframe.
product-jules: mention affected endpoints and mitigation done (routing to small-variant + scale up + memory bump).
sre-maya: final check: 5xx_rate now 1.1% over 5m window.
eng-ron: logs look clean, worker-7 healthy, restart_count reset after rolling update.
sre-maya: closing PD if no regressions in 15m. handoff: I'm passing to eng-ron for root-cause deeper analysis and RCA doc.
eng-ron: oncall handover noted. I'll collect heap dumps and correlate with seq_len distribution.
sre-maya: resolved marker planned at 1943220015 if stable.
pd-bot: INC-89421 will be auto-resolved if there are no alerts for 15m.
product-jules: thanks all. support-anya please coordinate customer comms. :thumbsup:
support-anya: will do — posting update and creating follow-up ticket for customer outreach.
eng-ron: quick TODOs captured: (1) heap dump + memory profile, (2) better seq_len guarding in model server, (3) autoscaler tweak to spin up earlier on queue depth.
sre-maya: adding postmortem owner eng-ron. I'll mark incident 'mitigated' in the internal tracker.
incidentbot: :white_check_mark: Incident INC-89421 mitigated — current 5xx_rate 1.1% (EU-west2).
eng-ron: creating RCA draft in /docs/incidents/1943218765-rca.md
sre-maya: thanks team. closing thread.
